While the sector median sales growth sits at 18.6% [E53], the company has delivered a compounded sales growth of -3% over the last three years [E14] and a marginal 3% over the trailing twelve months [E15]. This inability to capture sector tailwinds suggests a fundamental disconnect, further highlighted by the scanX signal engine which indicates that price growth is currently outpacing profit growth by 30% [E39]. Investors are essentially paying a premium for expectations that the company’s delivery has failed to meet [E39]. Furthermore, the lack of any dividend yield provides no income cushion for shareholders while they wait for this growth trajectory to potentially reverse [E4]. This stagnation is particularly concerning when compared to the sector median sales growth of 18.6% [E53], suggesting that the company is losing market relevance despite its internal efficiency. The bull’s reliance on valuation discounts [E6], [E7] ignores the reality that the market is already pricing in these growth failures, as indicated by the scanX signal engine which confirms that price growth is currently running 30% ahead of actual profit delivery [E39]. Consequently, the valuation multiples [E1], [E2] appear less like a bargain and more like a reflection of a business struggling to capture the growth enjoyed by its peers [E53].
